title: Dark Void Accuracy Fix
description: This datapack help you fix Dark Void Accuracy from 50% back to its original 80%
body:
This data pack helps you mod the Dark Void accuracy back up to 80%

You can change the accuracy in the json file at the /moves folder

How to add:
1. Download the file
2. Go to /saves and go to your World Name
3. Go to /datapacks
4. Paste the .zip file in
5. Unzip the file and delete the .zip file
6. Go to the game and use the command /reload
7. Then use /datapack list . You should see the file name in there
8. If you can not see it, use /datapack enable cobblemon_darkvoid_fix
9. Then reload again and check /datapack list  again

IT WILL ONLY SHOW 50% IN THE GAME, BUT IT IS ACTUALLY 80%!!!

You can use this same format to add on any other skills you want to modify

ENJOY!!!
